verdict.rationale: Fathom runs several fixed background automations: automatic CRM field sync after meetings, automatic topic monitoring and keyword alerts, and instant AI summaries. It also offers configurable webhooks that push meeting data (summary, transcript, action items) to a URL when new meetings arrive, so users can build their own event-driven pipelines. However, there is no first-party automation or agent builder; custom autonomous workflows require users to host their own webhook receivers or external tooling. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/workflow builder, autonomous agent actions beyond preset features, scheduling or trigger customization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
